title: PHP Conference Nagoya 2025
content:
PHP Conference Nagoya will be held for the first time in 2025.

The conference aims to promote interaction between Nagoya engineers and engineers across the country, and to bring a breath of fresh air to the Nagoya engineering community. (This conference will be conducted in Japanese.)

For more information, see . PHP Conference Nagoya 2025

Basic facts
